import json,sys,copy,hashlib,datetime
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/national')
from assemble import assemble,read_json
from location_lifecycle import digest
N=Path('data/national/kanto-prefecture/ibaraki/round2');E=Path('data/evidence/kanto-prefecture/ibaraki/round2')
def save(p,v):p.write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
updates=[];bindings=[];rows=[]
for group in ['parent','tsuchiura','coastal','south']:
 d=read_json(N/group/'outcomes.json');rs=d.get('facilities',d.get('results'));us=read_json(N/group/'locations-proposed.json')['updates'];bs=read_json(N/group/'location-lifecycle-proposed.json')['bindings'];updates+=us;bindings+=bs
 for r in rs:
  fid=r['facilityId'];u=next((u for u in us if u['facilityId']==fid),None)
  rows.append(dict(facilityId=fid,name=r['name'],group=group,performed='official-distribution-history-primary-building-numerical-comparison',candidateCoordinate=u['coordinate'] if u else None,result='candidate-unapproved' if u else 'building-correspondence-unresolved',detailRef=str(N/group/'outcomes.json')+' facilityId='+fid,geometryRef=r.get('geometryRef'),adoptionApproved=False,manifestApplied=False,remaining='independent building/CRS review' if u else 'JR原本403。高架下本体という回答済み。ホーム屋根と駅舎本体外形の対応確認が残る。'))
assert len(rows)==len({r['facilityId'] for r in rows})==18
assert len(updates)==len({u['facilityId'] for u in updates})==17
save(N/'outcomes.json',dict(schema=1,asOf='2026-11-05',summary=dict(targets=18,actuallyInvestigated=18,candidates=17,buildingCorrespondenceUnresolved=1,unstarted=0,adopted=0),facilities=sorted(rows,key=lambda x:x['facilityId'])))
save(N/'locations-proposed.json',dict(schema=1,updates=updates));save(N/'location-lifecycle-proposed.json',dict(schema=1,bindings=bindings,events=[],groups=[]))
sel=dict(schema=1,status='PROPOSED ONLY; NOT APPROVED; supersedes initial single-Moriya selection; do not combine both',locations=[dict(path=str(N/'locations-proposed.json'),approved=[dict(facilityId=u['facilityId'],sha256=digest(u)) for u in updates])],locationLifecycle=[dict(path=str(N/'location-lifecycle-proposed.json'),sha256=hashlib.sha256((N/'location-lifecycle-proposed.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest())])
save(N/'manifest-selection-proposed.json',sel)
m=read_json(Path('tools/national/manifest.json'));before,a=assemble(Path('.').resolve(),m);m['locations']+=sel['locations'];m['locationLifecycle']+=sel['locationLifecycle'];after,b=assemble(Path('.').resolve(),m)
changed={p['id'] for p,q in zip(before['places'],after['places']) if p!=q};assert changed=={u['facilityId'] for u in updates}
assert {k:v for k,v in before.items() if k!='places'}=={k:v for k,v in after.items() if k!='places'}
assert len(before['places'])==len(after['places'])==1586
ids={r['facilityId'] for r in rows};save(E/'old-values.json',dict(places=[p for p in before['places'] if p['id'] in ids],relations=[r for r in before['relations'] if r['placeId'] in ids]))
for u in updates:
 ev=u['evidence'];assert hashlib.sha256(Path(ev['snapshotPath']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==ev['snapshotSHA256'];assert ev['checkedAt']=='2026-11-05'
print('PASS 18 unique assigned IDs; 18 actual investigation records; 17 proposed coordinates; one documented correspondence hold')
print('PASS current assemble accepts all 17 explicit selection / canonical hash / binding proposals')
print('PASS full ledger difference exactly 17 place IDs; all other ledger sections and 1670 relations unchanged')
print('PASS all 17 evidence raw hashes and checkedAt preserved; actual shared manifest unchanged')
print('UNAPPROVED: historical 588 actual unlocated; hypothetical 571 only. CRS and independent identity review pending.')
